official.deadline_central_display: 10 January - 20 February each year for the full-time programmes (associate, bachelor's, master's, PhD and art scholarships); the 2026 window ran 10 January - 20 February 2026 and the 2027 dates have not been separately announced
official.deadline_note: YTB publishes the general application period as 10 January to 20 February, 'which is the application period every year'. Research Scholarships run on separate periods (four rounds per year) and the Success Scholarship is announced in October-November, as listed on the official application calendar.
official.application_cycle: Annual cycle: application 10 January - 20 February, evaluation March-April, interviews April-June, results early August, initial procedures August, transfer of grantees to Turkiye September
official.status_note: The general application window is 10 January - 20 February each year. With the 2026 cycle concluded (results announced early August 2026), the next full-time application window opens in January 2027.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official programme page lists 'Tuition Fee' as a component of the scholarship and states 'your university tuition is covered by Turkiye Scholarships'.
benefits: Monthly stipend: 6.500 TL at associate and bachelor's level, 9.500 TL at master's level, 13.000 TL at PhD level
Merit Scholarship Program: a monthly stipend twice the regular amount for academically qualified students
University and department placement, unlike other higher education scholarship programmes
Full tuition fee coverage at the host university
One year of free Turkish language education, with all awardees who do not hold a C1 Turkish certificate required to reach C1 by the end of the academic year
General health insurance for all international scholarship students
Once-off flight ticket at the beginning of the education and when graduating
Free academic and cultural programmes, student clubs and the International Student Academy
eligibility: Open to candidates of all countries; applications are made through the Turkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS)
Candidates can select up to 12 university and department choices in the online application
Candidates can only choose from the universities and departments offered to them in the system, which vary by educational background
Turkiye Scholarships does not award scholarships in the field of health sciences
Before applying, candidates are advised to check the equivalence and validity of the chosen fields in their own countries
Undergraduate candidates with international qualifications such as SAT or GCSE instead of national exam results must provide the minimum required qualifications for completing secondary school
requirements: All applications are examined on basic criteria such as minimum academic achievement, age limits set for each level of education, and required documents
Candidates must upload all required documents to TBBS; incomplete files fail at the preliminary assessment stage
PhD applications require a proposal for a research topic and a written example of research already carried out
Awardees who do not hold a C1 Turkish proficiency certificate must attend the one-year Turkish language course and attain C1 by the end of the academic year
documents: Valid identity document, ID card or passport
Photograph of the candidate taken within the last 1 year
International exam results (GRE, GMAT, SAT, etc.) if required by the chosen university or programme
International language test results such as TOEFL or DELF if required by the chosen university or programme
Research topic proposal and a written example of previous research (PhD applications only)
selection_criteria: Applications are considered according to the candidate's academic success, social activities and motivation related to the chosen field

Expert Committee evaluation of academic status, previous qualifications, academic interests, career goals, consistency of preferences, content of the letter of intent and participation in social activities
Undergraduate candidates sit a 30-question quantitative test (mathematics, geometry, logic) before the face-to-face interview
Face-to-face interview of 15-30 minutes covering purpose of application, academic knowledge and career goals
Final assessment by a selection committee, which confirms the general eligibility of the candidate
coverage: Monthly stipend by level (6.500 TL undergraduate, 9.500 TL master's, 13.000 TL PhD)
Once-off flight ticket at the beginning of the education and when graduating
application_method: Register and apply online through the Turkiye Scholarships Application System (TBBS)
Upload all required documents to the system during the 10 January - 20 February window
Select up to 12 university and department choices from those offered to you in the system
Shortlisted candidates are invited to the test and face-to-face interview run by the Presidential Delegations
official.application_route: Apply free of charge through the TBBS portal between 10 January and 20 February, upload the documents listed on the official 5-steps page, and choose up to 12 university/department options offered to you in the system.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of all countries; no residency restriction is published, though candidates are advised to check the equivalence and validity of their chosen fields in their own country
official.international_eligibility: Yes: the programme is designed for international students and applicants from all countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No scholarships in the field of health sciences; the universities and departments open to a candidate depend on their educational background
official.research_requirement: PhD applications require a research topic proposal and a written example of research already carried out
official.duration: One year of Turkish language education before or alongside the degree programme; associate degrees last two years, with bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes of standard length
official.description: Turkiye Scholarships (Turkiye Burslari) is the Republic of Turkiye's government scholarship programme for international students, coordinated by the Presidency of Turks Abroad and Relatives of Overseas Citizens (YTB), and distinctive in placing the student in a university and department rather than awarding a fellowship to spend at a chosen institution.
official.english_requirement: No programme-wide English score is published. Candidates who wish to study in English-medium programmes must be able to provide an internationally accepted language proficiency certificate (TOEFL or equivalent) where the university officially states it is required; most such programmes also require international admission test results (GRE, GMAT, SAT).

not_confirmed: funding_amount - the monthly stipend is published as three different figures by study level (6.500 TL undergraduate, 9.500 TL master's, 13.000 TL PhD), so no single programme amount is recorded
deadline_central - YTB publishes 10 January - 20 February as the annual window but has not yet announced dated 2027 deadlines
verification.notes: Stipend figures, tuition coverage, Turkish course, accommodation, insurance and the flight ticket were read from the official full-time programmes page and the 'Why Turkiye Scholarships' page; documents and the C1 Turkish rule from the 5-steps page; selection stages from the evaluation and selection page; the annual window and result timeline from the application calendar. Note that many third-party sites quote lower stipend figures (for example 3,500-9,000 TL) that do not match the awarding body's own pages.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a placement scholarship, not a pick-your-university fellowship: you rank up to 12 university and department options in TBBS and YTB decides where you go, so read the programme descriptions of every option before you rank them. Budget your effort around three gates - the file screening in March-April, a 30-question quantitative test and a face-to-face interview between April and June, and results only in early August, which leaves barely a month before the September transfer to Turkiye. The stipend differs sharply by level (6,500 TL undergraduate, 9,500 TL master's, 13,000 TL PhD), so the same award is worth very different things depending on which programme you land in.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong all-round applicants with community or social activity track records who are comfortable being placed at a university they did not choose, including those who want a free Turkish year.
application_readiness_checklist: Open TBBS and check which universities and departments the system actually offers for your educational background before drafting anything
Verify that the field you want is recognised and equivalent in your own country, as YTB explicitly warns about this
Prepare the research proposal and a written sample of prior research if you are applying at PhD level
Rank your 12 choices honestly - the system only lets you choose what is offered, and placement, not preference, decides your university
Book interview availability for April-June and be ready to bring original certificates to the interview
common_rejection_risks: Missing or unreadable uploads: the preliminary assessment screens on minimum academic achievement, age limits and required documents before anyone reads your motivation
Choosing health sciences, which the programme explicitly does not fund
Weak consistency between your ranked choices, your letter of intent and your career goals, which the Expert Committee scores directly
Failing the 30-question quantitative test or the interview, which are held in person by the Presidential Delegations
Assuming an English-medium placement without the language certificate the chosen university requires
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Anything beyond tuition, dormitory accommodation, the monthly stipend, insurance and the two flights: personal spending, transport within Turkiye, additional travel home, and any costs tied to the university you are placed at.
document_audit: The photograph must have been taken within the last year, and the identity document must be valid at application time
A temporary graduation certificate is accepted in place of a diploma, but it must be uploaded - not promised later
National exam results are only required 'if any', but international exam results become mandatory when the chosen university or programme demands them
PhD files need two separate items: a proposal for the research topic and a written example of research already carried out
alerts: The application window is short and fixed (10 January - 20 February); there is no rolling entry for the full-time programmes
Results arrive in early August and grantees transfer to Turkiye in September, so visa and travel planning must start before the award letter
The Merit Scholarship Program doubles the monthly stipend but is judged on GPA plus ALES/GRE/SAT and TOEFL/IELTS thresholds, which must already exist at application time
Research Scholarships and the Success Scholarship run entirely separate calendars, including a Success window in October-November
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Online only, through TBBS: register, upload documents, rank up to 12 offered options, then sit the test and in-person interview if shortlisted.
